profile.title: Profile
profile.pictureDescription: An image address Berry can load. Berry does not host uploads yet.
profile.emailDescription: Changing this needs a verification step Berry does not have yet.
profile.name: Full name
profile.aboutDescription: Agents working with you are given this as context. Written once, true everywhere.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: What you work on, and what you want agents to know.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: What this workspace is called, and what it tells its agents.
general.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these.
general.logoDescription: An image address Berry can load. Berry does not host uploads yet.
general.name: Workspace name
general.slugDescription: Fixed. It is in every link to this workspace, and Berry has no redirect from an old one.
general.descriptionDescription: What this workspace is for. Shown to people deciding whether to join.
general.contextDescription: Given to every agent working here, on top of what each one knows.
general.contextPlaceholder: House rules, conventions, and anything an agent should never do.
general.prefixDescription: The letters in front of every task number. Two to ten characters, starting with a letter.
general.prefixInvalid: Two to ten letters or digits, starting with a letter.
general.prefixFailed: The prefix could not be changed.
general.prefixConfirmBody: Every task reference in this workspace changes at once: {before} becomes {after}. Links and pasted references using the old prefix will no longer resolve.
general.leaveDescription: You lose access until someone invites you back.
general.leaveSoleOwner: You are the only owner. Make someone else an owner first, or delete the workspace.
general.leaveConfirmBody: You will lose access to {name} until someone invites you back.
general.leaveFailed: You could not be removed from this workspace.
general.deleteDescription: Removes it for everyone in it. This cannot be undone from the app.
general.deleteConfirmBody: Everyone loses access to {name}, its tasks, and its history. Type the workspace name to confirm.
general.deleteFailed: The workspace could not be deleted.

members.title: Members
members.inviteDescription: They join this workspace at the role you pick.
members.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be created.
members.inviteTokenBody: Berry does not send mail, so this link is the invitation. It is shown once — Berry kept only a hash of it.
members.ownerOnly: only an owner can change this
members.roleFailed: That role could not be changed.
members.removeBody: {name} loses access to this workspace. Their tasks and comments stay.
members.removeFailed: That member could not be removed.
members.revokeFailed: That invitation could not be revoked.
members.joinLinksDescription: A shareable link anyone can use to join, at a role you fix in advance.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.subtitle: Keys that act as you, for scripts and your own integrations.
tokens.newDescription: The key itself is shown once, when you create it.
tokens.name: What is it for?
tokens.expiryDescription: A key that never expires is one you will forget you made.
tokens.scopesFullHint: Full access, like signing in as you
tokens.scopesLimitedHint: Only the public API scopes ticked here
tokens.createFailed: The key could not be created.
tokens.replayed: That key already existed; its secret cannot be shown again.
tokens.secretBody: This is the only time Berry can show it — only a hash was stored. If you lose it, revoke this key and create another.
tokens.stored: I have stored it somewhere safe
tokens.revokeBody: Anything using {name} stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.subtitle: Workspaces that have asked you to join.
invitations.loadFailed: Your invitations could not be loaded.
invitations.emptyHint: Invitations sent to you will appear here.
invitations.acceptFailed: None of those invitations could be accepted.

invite.readyBody: You have been invited as {role}. This invitation expires {when}.
invite.declinedBody: Nobody was notified. The invitation stays open until it expires, so you can follow the link again if you change your mind.
invite.unavailableBody: It may have been withdrawn or expired, or it may be addressed to a different account. Berry does not say which, so that a link cannot be used to find out.
invite.failedBody: Berry could not check this invitation. Try the link again.

newWorkspace.title: New workspace
newWorkspace.subtitle: A workspace has its own members, tasks and settings.
newWorkspace.name: Name
newWorkspace.slugHint: Berry will serve it at {url}. This cannot be changed later.
newWorkspace.slugInvalid: Use 2-50 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
newWorkspace.slugReserved: That address is reserved by Berry.
newWorkspace.prefixInvalid: Use 2-10 characters: a letter first, then letters or digits.
newWorkspace.descriptionPlaceholder: What this workspace is for. Agents read it too.
newWorkspace.createFailed: The workspace could not be created.

preferences.stickyCommentBar: Keep the comment box in view
preferences.stickyCommentBarDescription: Pin it to the bottom of a task instead of letting it scroll away with the activity. Stored in this browser.
preferences.issueDescription: Which selectors the task composer shows. Anything hidden takes the workspace default. Stored in this browser.
preferences.floatingChatDescription: Let chat follow you as a panel, instead of only on its own page. Stored in this browser.

labels.title: Labels
labels.issueLead: The vocabulary a task can be tagged with.
labels.skillLead: The labels skills are catalogued by. They are written on each skill, so this lists what is in use rather than a catalogue you can edit.
labels.createFailed: That label could not be created.
labels.name: Name
labels.removeBody: {count} tasks carry this label. They keep it, and it stops being offered for anything new.
labels.removeBodyUnknown: Tasks that carry this label keep it, and it stops being offered for anything new.
labels.skillEmpty: No skill carries a label yet.

properties.title: Task fields
properties.lead: Custom fields every task in this workspace can carry.
properties.kindIsFixed: The type is fixed once the field exists, because the values already stored were checked against it.
properties.atCapacity: This workspace is at its limit. Archive a field to make room.
properties.createFailed: The field could not be created.
properties.restoreFailed: The field could not be restored.
properties.archivedLead: Archived fields are not offered on tasks, and the values already stored are kept.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.lead: Saved prompts an agent runs on a task. Berry fills in {variables}; anything else is refused.
quickActions.staleHint: Nobody has run this in {days} days.
quickActions.unfillable: Berry cannot fill {names}. Remove it, or use one of the variables above.
quickActions.restrictedAgent: Not everyone here can start {agent}, so this action will fail for them. Make it private, or widen who may use the agent.
quickActions.createFailed: The quick action could not be created.
quickActions.restoreFailed: The quick action could not be restored.
quickActions.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Runs that already used it are unaffected — they carry the prompt they were given, not a link back to this.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.lead: What a task can be in, and what a project can be in.
statuses.readOnly: Only an owner or an admin can change these. You are seeing them as they are.
statuses.addLead: A status belongs to one board column, which decides what Berry and its agents do with a task in it.
statuses.categoryIsFixed: The column is fixed once the status exists: the board and the run ledger address a status by its column, so moving one would move every task in it.
statuses.createFailed: The status could not be created.
statuses.restoreFailed: The status could not be restored.
statuses.archiveBody: Tasks in this status are moved out of it and left without one. The status can be brought back, but the tasks are not put back into it.
statuses.archivedLead: Not offered on tasks. Bring one back and it returns to its column.
statuses.agentNote_backlog: Agents leave these alone. Nothing here is picked up on its own.
statuses.agentNote_todo: An agent assigned a task here starts work on it.
statuses.agentNote_in_progress: A run is under way, or is expected to be. Berry will not start a second one.
statuses.agentNote_in_review: Work is finished and waiting on a person. Agents stop here rather than carrying on.
statuses.agentNote_blocked: Something outside Berry is in the way. Agents do not retry a task here.
statuses.agentNote_done: Closed. Runs stop and the task leaves the queues.
statuses.agentNote_cancelled: Closed without the work being done. Treated as done by everything that schedules.
statuses.projectLead: Fixed. These are part of what a project means, not a workspace preference.
